scope.policy_under_test: 64 KiB mature exact-Deflate cutoff plus exact Deflate streams referenced by the largest regular selected S_VZIP member

interpretation.causal_result: Selecting small exact-Deflate streams solely because they are referenced by the largest regular selected S_VZIP member is effectively inert on this frozen 15-workload oracle. Fourteen of fifteen rows are byte-identical to retain-all. The only changed row, deflate_family, collapses to the mature-cutoff artifact, saves 2203 bytes versus retain-all, but violates the <=8x locality contract at 13.914x and remains 976 bytes above the accepted-v0.29 reference.
interpretation.scope_warning: This oracle exercises the r24 fallback component directly. Its 181.1 MB aggregate is not the canonical v0.30 complete-product aggregate and must not be compared as if it were release-product evidence. The accepted-v0.29 numbers are reference context only.
interpretation.next_question: The fallback debt is not explained by ownership of small exact-Deflate streams for one largest member. Future work should target a different causal owner: complete fallback construction/selection semantics, effort allocation, metadata/framing, or a representation boundary with measurable headroom. Do not rescue this policy through workload-specific thresholds.
interpretation.anti_goodhart: No benchmark identity, comparator, success threshold, locality ceiling, or semantic contract was weakened after observing the result.
